reopen the completed motion/recursion lower bounds or require a uniform
parameter generator. Existing NativeIO, NativeIOEmbedding, NativeMicrocode,

no operations, input/output costs or clearing obligations are discarded.

refinement used by the compiler. No existing exact masked stride routine
was found in the searched local modules; no exhaustive absence claim.
